title: A paired test did not resolve a decrease in May nitrate enrichment at two Gulf river outlets in 1980-2025
abstract: We tested whether May nitrate concentration fell relative to annual concentration at the Mississippi and Atchafalaya river outlets. We reused verified monthly totals from USGS release 3.0 and compared 1980-1996 with 2009-2025. The pooled May-to-annual concentration ratio fell from 1.139 to 1.059, a 7.00% decrease. A paired three-year block test gave conditional 95% limits of -13.05% to +0.66%. Thus the primary test does not resolve a decrease. May water volume rose by 14.97% while May nitrate mass fell by 3.83%; these are point comparisons. Wider-season and period checks depend on the chosen window. This extends a prior load-share test with a paired mass-to-water statistic. It is not independent confirmation. Model estimates, short dependent records and absent source-error draws limit inference. No cause or hypoxia response is established. Code, monthly evidence, all resampling draws, source hashes, exact raw regeneration checks and a figure are included.

display.caption: May enrichment ratios and period changes. Intervals condition on archived source estimates and omit source model error.
